concept.reason: Original museum skeleton photograph and detailed anatomical description sufficient, no concept render.

scope: Whole animal with large downward upper tusks and shorter lower tusks, retracted nasal region with inferred short fleshy nose, substantial elongated low torso.

scientific_limits.en: Field Museum skeleton14251 is mounted lying down, not proof that living legs were extremely short.1990 paper reports1.37m shoulder and2.88m nose-to-pelvis for this specimen, not a species mean and not tail-inclusive total length.1935 popular account rounds to nearly5ft and9.5ft. Soft trunk/lip, pads, ears, tail outline and color inferred; no long elephant trunk. Actual forelimbs relatively strong and hindquarters lighter. Fossil skeleton includes reconstruction, not an untouched articulated carcass.
scientific_limits.zh: Field14251展架为卧姿，不能据此造极短腿。1990文献该件肩高1.37米/鼻尖到骨盆2.88米，非物种均值也不含尾全长；1935通俗文约五英尺/九点五英尺是约数。鼻唇、足垫、耳尾色为推断，无长象鼻；前肢强后躯较轻。展骨包含复原并非完整原状尸体。

classification: Mammalia, Astrapotheria, Astrapotheriidae; South American native ungulate, not elephant or tapir.

scale.status: Specimen dimensions quoted by Marshall etal1990; soft tissue and individual tusk lengths chosen estimates, not directly measured.

diagnostic_targets: Large long head with two upper canine tusks curving downward and a shorter paired lower set, no elephant-incisor arrangement.
High retracted nasal opening represented through short fleshy mobile nose/lip, clearly labeled inferred, no long dangling elephant trunk.
Substantial elongated low torso with deep chest, rather than spherical hippo or tall elephant body.
Strong forelimbs and lighter hindquarters; retain real joint heights rather than copying lying museum mount.
Broad padded support feet; five foredigits described in source but soft pads inferred, no huge separated claws.
Neutral inferred skin, moderate ears/tail; complete original animal not skull-only.
acceptance: Original long tusks/retracted nose/massive low body combination all evident.
Side shows two upper and lower tusk routes without intersections; front proves bilateral pairs.
Standing legs structurally coherent and not copied in folded mount pose.
Lengths reported nose-to-pelvis distinguished from total includingtail and soft estimates.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review.
